description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutablePermissions class, verifying immutability, equality, permissions creation, containment, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ImmutablePermissionsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior and immutability of ImmutablePermissions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Permissions instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutablePermissions instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Uses EqualsVerifier to test the equals and hashCode contract for ImmutablePermissions.

methods.name: createNewMutablePermissionsFromGivenSet
methods.description: Creates a new Permissions instance from a set and verifies its contents.

methods.name: containsWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the contains method correctly reports permissions.

methods.name: createJsonRepresentationOfEmptyMutablePermissions
methods.description: Verifies that an empty Permissions instance serializes to an empty JSON array.
